name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-super-mario-land-fly
title: Redrawn Styled Super Mario Land Fly
description:
Custom graphics for smkdan's Super Mario Land 1 Fly custom sprite, meant to be used alongside Icegoom's redrawn graphics.

Comes in 3 different designs: Classic (meant to use Palette B); Mario & Luigi's (meant for Palette D); and Super Mario Land's (which goes with Palette A). Custom palettes for all three varations are included, but be aware you'll need to edit the sprite's .cfg file if you want it to use palette B/D.

Give credit to me if used, as it's always appreciated.
